Class BuildActivity

java.lang.Object
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.BuildActivity
public final class BuildActivity extends Object
Records what a session built and how long it took — the work the receipt summarizes before it lists anything that went wrong.

Fed by BuildReportSpy from project and mojo execution events. Timing is this collector's own clock, started when the session is reset at project discovery, so the wall time covers the same span as Maven's Total time line. Under a parallel build module times overlap and sum to more than the wall time; the receipt says so rather than hiding it.

The collector also answers "what is this thread building right now?" (current()), which is what lets a console warning be attributed to the module and goal that produced it.

    • current

      public BuildActivity.Context current()
      Says what the calling thread is building.

      A plugin may log from a thread of its own — a forked JVM's stream pump, for instance. When the calling thread is not a build thread and exactly one module is in flight, that module is the only candidate and is returned.

      Returns:
      the calling thread's context, or BuildActivity.Context.NONE
